title: Amazon S3 Fundamentals
summary: Buckets, object keys and size limits, then who can access S3 (IAM policies, bucket policies, ACLs off by default, Block Public Access), static website hosting, versioning and delete markers, cross-Region and same-Region replication, and every storage class from Standard to Glacier Deep Archive and Express One Zone with durability, availability, minimums and prices.
